name: Eastern Creek 1 (EC1)

address.note: Campus address; Lot 2 DP 1159804 per SSD-10330 SEARs request.

lat.note: Not geocoded: Nominatim and other geocoders (and all planning/operator sites) were blocked by the session's egress proxy. Geocode 17 Roberts Road, Eastern Creek NSW 2766 (Lot 2 DP 1159804) later.

lon.note: Not geocoded: Nominatim and other geocoders (and all planning/operator sites) were blocked by the session's egress proxy. Geocode 17 Roberts Road, Eastern Creek NSW 2766 (Lot 2 DP 1159804) later.

builder.note: Original building constructed for HP (Aurora, 2011-12); head contractor not found.

developer.note: Original developer of the building housing EC1; site later owned by DXC Technology and acquired by CDC 14 Dec 2018 (source 1).

mw_it.note: 6 MW per CDC Oct 2019 deck; DCD Dec 2022 gives 7 MW (source 7).

cost_aud_m.note: HP reported initial A$119m build, ~A$200m spent on whole Aurora site by 2012 (source 4); not specific to EC1.

authority.note: Original HP-era approval not identified; CDC's SSD-10330 (2020) covers later buildings.

jobs_construction.note: Not found; EIS jobs figures not accessible (portal blocked). CDC says campus construction since 2018 'created hundreds of jobs'.

construction_end.note: EC1 is inferred to be one of the two pre-existing ex-HP/DXC data halls (source 2); HP Aurora first services 1 Dec 2011, formal opening June 2012 (source 3).

open_questions: scope: EC1 appears to be a pre-existing ex-HP 'Aurora' data hall (built 2011-12, acquired by CDC from DXC 14 Dec 2018 as an operational data centre), i.e. completed before 2018-09-01; likely out of scope unless CDC's re-commissioning counts as new build.
